tagline: Travel through Latin America with calm, discretion and eyes wide open
description: PAB is a travel magazine for Latin America: beaches, cities, mountains, jungles, road trips and local cuisine, with practical guides to plan, spend wisely and travel respectfully.
author: PAB Editorial

playas-y-costas.name: Beaches and coasts
playas-y-costas.description: Caribbean, Pacific and Atlantic: when to go, how to get around, where to swim safely and how to take care of the sea you visit.

ciudades-y-cultura.name: Cities and culture
ciudades-y-cultura.description: Historic centers, museums, neighborhoods, festivals and architecture: how to explore Latin American cities without rushing.

montanas-y-naturaleza.name: Mountains and nature
montanas-y-naturaleza.description: Andes, jungles, deserts and national parks: altitude, climate, equipment and trails to enjoy safely.

rutas-por-carretera.name: Road routes
rutas-por-carretera.description: Travel by car, bus and train: itineraries, realistic distances, documents, fuel and worthwhile stops.

planificacion-y-presupuesto.name: Planning and budget
planificacion-y-presupuesto.description: Documents, insurance, money, traveler's health and luggage: what should be resolved before leaving home.

sabores-del-viaje.name: Flavors of travel
sabores-del-viaje.description: Markets, regional cuisines and traditional drinks: eat well and with respect in each destination.
